posts.title: FEAR of AI’s SMART—SAPIOMECHANOPHOBIA?

posts.title: FAA’s Cancellation of the Cessna Single-Pilot Exemption Warrants Further Review
posts.description: FAA’s Cancellation of the Cessna Single-Pilot Exemption Warrants Further Review Quote 1 Holding of an exemption, ipso facto , does not qualify as a right . The issuance and operation of about 1,250 U.S.-REGISTERED CITATION MODELS [today] under this action since 1984 may merit further review per Supreme Court cases and good regulatory practice. Under 49 U.S.C. § 44701(f) and 14 C.F.R. § 11.81(e) FAA may grant an exemption when it is in the public interest and provides an equivalent level of safety . posts.title: Boeing’s Chief Safety Officer highlights a practice that builds trust and engages everyone in effective risk management
posts.description: Boeing’s chief aerospace safety office, a/ka/ (?) ACCOUNTABLE EXECUTIVE , told his peers at the International Aviation Safety Summit in Montreal that the FREE FLOW OF SAFETY INFORMATION is CRUCIAL to reducing risk in his company . The specific image conveyed by his talk is, like the above AI image, the SMS team leaders spending time on the shop floor. His message was impactful, but brief, i.e., right length for the audience. It might be helpful to add some of the experiences that move the relationship from that the participants will NOT BE PUNISHED , which is an SMS essential, to a more proactive, positive realm of TRUST and contribution. ►SMS depends on data, but the data originate with people. The Safety Review team analyzes hazards, assesses risk, identifies trends, and track mitigations only to the extent that employees are willing to notice, interpret, and communicate weak safety signals . ► That process is summarized by these steps— EMPLOYEE VIGILANCE → REPORTING → BETTER SAFETY
